row.title: Lavender and Lies V7
row.style: electronicore, heavy metalcore, deathcore breakdowns, aggrotech, 155 bpm, 4/4 meter, heavy double-kick drums, blast beats, downtuned 7-string chugs, aggressive female screamed vocals, sparse male guttural growls, soaring melodic chorus, distorted supersaw synth, explosive electronic metal mix
row.lyrics:
[Intro]
(heavy electronic chugs, blast beat)
(male deep guttural roar)
SCENT IS GONE!
(female brutal scream)
THAT IS NOT ME!

[Verse 1]
(female screamed, fast technical delivery)
Date by the graveyard! Moon in the sky!
One little perfume! Give it a try!
Spray on the collar! Sweetness in the air!
Finally something nice in my fur and hair!
Step past the sentries! Watch them bare their teeth!
What is this stranger they smell underneath?!
My sister backs off! My brother blocks the gate!
That bargain witch has wrecked my bloody date!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female panicked scream, male backing growl)
Scent gone! (Male: WHO?)
Pack turns! (Male: WAIT!)
Look at my eyes! (Male: STRANGER!)
Open the gate!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing, heavy metalcore beat)
Lavender and lies beneath a borrowed skin!
My own pack thinks a stranger wants to bite!
I only wanted one night looking lovely!
Now I fight to prove that I belong tonight!

[Verse 2]
(female aggressive metalcore scream)
I know your names! Know the crack in the wall!
Know who stole the sausages! Know who took the fall!
Brother almost laughs, then the perfume hits his nose!
Every shared memory drowned beneath the rose!
Witch at the treeline! Whistle in her teeth!
Calling up a demon from the roots beneath!
Sold me a disguise to turn my pack away!
Now she wants the gate! Now she has to pay!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female panicked scream, male backing growl)
Scent gone! (Male: WHO?)
Pack turns! (Male: WAIT!)
Look at my eyes! (Male: STRANGER!)
Open the gate!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing)
Lavender and lies beneath a borrowed skin!
My own pack thinks a stranger wants to bite!
I only wanted one night looking lovely!
Now I fight to prove that I belong tonight!

[Verse 3]
(female fast rap-scream, heavy 808 sub bass)
Claws in my collar! Splash into the ditch!
So much for romance! Thank you, little witch!
Water makes it stronger! Now the flowers bloom!
I smell like every funeral inside a tiny room!
Roll in the fox muck! Scrub against the pine!
Strip that stolen sweetness! Give me back what is mine!
Mud in my muzzle! Branches in my braid!
Nobody could miss the filthy wolf I made!

[Bridge]
(crushing deathcore breakdown, heavy double-bass)
(male deep roar)
LOOK AT THAT MESS!
(female brutal scream)
I KNOW, SHUT UP!
(male deep roar)
SMELLS LIKE HOME!
(female screams with immense rage)
YOU WILL NOT TAKE MY PACK FROM ME!
SHATTER THE FLASK! SEND THE DEMONS BACK!
(male and female dual shout)
CLAIM OUR TRACK!

[Guitar Solo & Synth Breakdown]
(heavy downtuned 7-string chugs, screeching acid synths)

[Verse 4]
(female fast aggressive delivery)
Sister catches scent! Throws the bolt aside!
Turn to meet the witch with my pack at my side!
Break her little whistle! Bite the silver charm!
Demon takes its keeper! Woods go dark and calm!
He meets me at the gate with a flower and a blush!
Says he likes the girl, but recommends a brush!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, full anthemic power)
Lavender and lies beneath a borrowed skin!
My own pack thinks a stranger wants to bite!
I only wanted one night looking lovely!
Now I fight to prove that I belong tonight!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum aggression, dual screamed and soaring vocals)
Lavender and lies beneath a borrowed skin!
My own pack thinks a stranger wants to bite!
I only wanted one night looking lovely!
Now I fight to prove that I belong tonight!

[Outro]
(fading downtuned guitar chugs)
(female whispered growl)
Pack is safe... date is waiting...
(male low echo growl)
Bath is calling...
(female brutal final scream)
NOBODY BUY ME PERFUME!

row.title: Pitch and Panic V7

Witch runs into the charcoal mill!
Brother follows against my will!
Black tar bubbling through the floor!
Living shadows guard the door!
One paw down and the pitch bites tight!
Other paw sticks when I try to fight!
I came out here to get him free!

Wood cracks! (Male: HOLD!)
Tail stuck! (Male: STAY!)

Pitch and panic in the burning mill!
Trying to run while the floor holds still!
Brother needs a wolf to get him through!
He got a furious rug stuck fast in glue!

[Verse 2]
(female aggressive metalcore scream, heavy 7-string chugs)
Every tug strips out a tuft!
Demons think I have had enough!
One comes grinning with a saw!
Catch the handle in my free claw!
Tar crawls up my ankle bone!
Brother calls in a frightened tone!
I can lose some fur and take the sting!
She cannot take my everything!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male backing response)
Pitch grabs! (Male: PULL!)
Wood cracks! (Male: HOLD!)

Kick the ash-bin onto its side!
Dry black dust makes the sticky pitch slide!
Roll my wrists through the broken coal!
Pull one paw from the hungry hole!
Three more steps and I reach the stair!
Half my winter coat stays back there!
Witch keeps laughing till I stand!
Ash-bin ready in my filthy hand!

[Interlude - Scent & Splinter Shift]
(glitchy synth arpeggios, atmospheric ambient pads, female breathless clean vocal)
Peeling off the black stuff... checking every toe...
Tail looks like a paintbrush... dipped in tar below...

My coat will never look the same again...

[Bridge - Symphonic Metalcore Escalation]
(progressive time-signature chugs, soaring orchestral strings)
(female frantic screamed delivery)
You thought your floor could make me watch in fear!
Thought I loved my coat too much to leave it here!

I will tear this mill apart for sure!

[Crushing Electronicore Breakdown]
(heavy double-bass, brutal sub-drop, screeching acid synths)
(male sub-bass chant)
CRACK THE BOILER!
(female brutal scream)
FREE HIS HANDS!
(male sub-bass chant)
BURN THE BINDING!
(female screams with immense rage)
TAKE MY FUR! YOU CANNOT TAKE MY BROTHER!
SMASH THE GEAR!
(male and female dual shout)
DRAG HIM CLEAR!

[Guitar Solo & Synth Breakdown]
(hyper-kinetic technical metalcore guitar solo, heavy supersaw arpeggios)

[Verse 4]
(female fast metalcore delivery)
Steam hits the rafters with a hiss!
Witch falls back to the tar-black kiss!
Brother off the hook and on my back!
One last kick and the timbers crack!
Land in the river with a splash!
He owes me a brush and all his cash!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, full anthemic power)
Pitch and panic in the burning mill!
Trying to run while the floor holds still!
Brother needs a wolf to get him through!
He got a furious rug stuck fast in glue!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum aggression, dual screamed and soaring vocals, full blast beat acceleration)
Pitch and panic in the burning mill!
Trying to run while the floor holds still!
Brother needs a wolf to get him through!
He got a furious rug stuck fast in glue!

[Outro]
(fading heavy electronic guitar chugs, quiet wind ambient pads)
(female satisfied growl)
Brother breathing... coat demolished...
(male low echo whisper)
Nice bald patches...
(female brutal final scream)
YOU ARE PICKING EVERY LAST BIT OUT!

(female rap-scream, fast technical delivery)
Skeletons charging through the fog!
Clattering teeth out in the bog!
Other wolves run, but I just smile!
I've been waiting for this a while!
Snap off a femur, bite the knee!
Crispy bone marrow set for me!
Best little snack in the whole graveyard!
Crunching them down and hitting hard!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male backing response)
Snap the rib! (Male: CRUNCH!)
Bite the joint! (Male: BITE!)
Shatter skull! (Male: SNACK!)

Best crispy treat that I've ever found!
Taking every femur right out of the ground!

[Verse 2]
(female fast soaring vocal, heavy 7-string chugs)
Then comes a slime monster from the mud!
Drenching my paws in green sticky sludge!
Got to sink my teeth in to tear it apart!
Grossest damn battle I ever had to start!
Tastes like battery acid and snot!
Gagging mid-fight on a slimy clot!
Why do I have to bite this sour blob?!

(female shouted, male backing response)

NO MORE SLIME!

MARROW TIME!

(male low echo whisper)
Good bone...

SAVE ME THE SKULL!

Royalty dead...

THIS DRESS WAS OVERPRICED ANYWAY!

row.title: The Ribbon and the Teeth V7
row.style: electronicore, heavy metalcore, synthwave metal, aggrotech, 168 bpm, 4/4 meter, heavy double-kick drums, downtuned 7-string chugs, aggressive female rap-screamed vocals, soaring melodic female chorus, sparse male sub-bass shouts, distorted supersaw synth, 808 sub-bass drops, explosive electronic metal mix
row.lyrics:
[Intro]
(screeching supersaw synth, fast double-kick drums)
(male sub-bass chant)
RED IN THE BRIARS!
(female frantic shriek)
THAT IS MY SISTER!

[Verse 1]
(female rap-scream, fast technical delivery)
Mother tied this scarlet braid!
Said a hunter need not fade!
Wore it hunting through the snow!
Last of her I cannot let go!
Sister asks for her first patrol!
Wants to feel a little bold!
Tie it tight! Stay near the stone!
Then a red scrap drifts back home!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male backing response)
Bow torn! (Male: TRACK!)
Scent lost! (Male: SEARCH!)
Claws out! (Male: RUN!)
Find the ruined church!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, light male backing, driving synth-metal beat)
Red ribbon caught in briars and teeth!
My sister hangs with the dead beneath!
I can lose the silk, but not her breath!
Let the forest take my pretty things instead!

[Verse 2]
(female aggressive metalcore scream, heavy 7-string chugs)
Thorns draw lines across my chest!
Rescues always wreck my best!
Witch has built a silver door!
Sister claws the broken floor!
Every tug unthreads her coat!
Dead hands reach to grab her throat!
Mother stitched that scarlet hem!
Now it is the lock that holds her in!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male backing response)
Bow torn! (Male: TRACK!)
Scent lost! (Male: SEARCH!)
Claws out! (Male: RUN!)
Find the ruined church!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, light male backing)
Red ribbon caught in briars and teeth!
My sister hangs with the dead beneath!
I can lose the silk, but not her breath!
Let the forest take my pretty things instead!

[Verse 3 - Trap-Metal Shift]
(female fast rap-scream, heavy 808 sub bass, glitchy synths)
Witch says choose which love to keep!
One is dead and one can bleed!
Sister whimpers she was wrong!
Says a stupid pup should stay at home!
Look at me! Stay on the stone!
You owe no witch your skin and bone!
Brother wedges in the gate!
Cut the bow before it is too late!

[Interlude - Scent & Splinter Shift]
(glitchy synth arpeggios, atmospheric ambient pads, female breathless clean vocal)
Teeth against the ribbon... taste the old wood smoke...
Mother in the kitchen... teaching me the knot...
Sister slipping... claws scrape rock...
Bite through the silk and break the lock...

[Bridge - Symphonic Metalcore Escalation]
(progressive time-signature chugs, soaring orchestral strings)
(female frantic screamed delivery)
You thought I loved the ribbon more than her!
Thought the dead could make my purpose blur!
Mother taught these teeth to hold and mend!
Her love is not the way my sister ends!

[Crushing Electronicore Breakdown]
(heavy double-bass, brutal sub-drop, screeching acid synths)
(male sub-bass chant)
HOLD THE CHAPEL!
(female brutal scream)
FREE HER COAT!
(male sub-bass chant)
SNAP THE SILVER!
(female screams with immense rage)
TAKE THE RIBBON! YOU CANNOT TAKE MY SISTER!
SHUT THE DOOR!
(male and female dual shout)
TAKE NO MORE!

[Guitar Solo & Synth Breakdown]
(hyper-kinetic technical metalcore guitar solo, heavy supersaw arpeggios)

[Verse 4]
(female fast metalcore delivery)
Silk snaps! Doorway bites the witch!
Brother pulls us from the ditch!
Check her paws and wipe her tears!
Keep your breath! You owe me no repairs!
One last thread caught on the stone!
Tie her wrist and take her home!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, full anthemic power)
Red ribbon caught in briars and teeth!
My sister hangs with the dead beneath!
I can lose the silk, but not her breath!
Let the forest take my pretty things instead!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum aggression, dual screamed and soaring vocals, full blast beat acceleration)
Red ribbon caught in briars and teeth!
My sister hangs with the dead beneath!
I can lose the silk, but not her breath!
Let the forest take my pretty things instead!

[Outro]
(fading heavy electronic guitar chugs, quiet wind ambient pads)
(female satisfied growl)
Sister safe... ribbon shortened...
(male low echo whisper)
Tail still tangled...
(female brutal final scream)
SOMEBODY FETCH THE GOOD COMB!
